description: Tournai - MVV - Analyse du réseau des voies vertes is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Tournai. Analyse du réseau des voies vertes à Tournai. Coverage: Tournai. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are voie, lent, environnement, maillag, tournai. The portal shows 2,438 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
